title: Nike missed out on a couple of MASSIVE opportunities at this world cu...
description: Nike missed out on a couple of MASSIVE opportunities at this world cup. You'd expect so much better from them...
transcript: Nike is showing you exactly how not to handle a sell out. So look at this. Norway have had a somewhat unbelievable run at the World Cup, but still, this is Nike, a 65 billion dollar company. They've been sold out for almost three weeks now. Now, understanding the shifts in demand for your products and moving mountains to ensure their stock. It's part of the job whether you're Nike or an independent retailer. But what's even worse than that is they aren't even doing any sort of lead generation. Capture people's email, tell them you'll notify when more stock is available. Give them an incentive to get a discount on a bundle. Nica literally leaving money on the table. Norway's hype has been and gone. Those three weeks could have been extremely profitable. Or at worst, they could have collected the leads and resold a portion of them shirts. Or even better, up sold the bigger bundles.
